story.headline: Give your developer a design for your product’s first-use flow.
story.body: Mina Studio reviews one existing onboarding or first-use flow, up to five screens, then delivers annotated Figma screens, a clickable prototype, one handoff call and one revision.
story.reason: Connects the founder’s design task to the artifacts their developer receives.

resonance.headline: Already have a product and a developer? Revisit first use.
resonance.body: Bring your existing onboarding or first-use flow, up to five screens. Mina Studio reviews it and delivers annotated Figma screens, a clickable prototype, one handoff call and one revision.
resonance.reason: Opens with the existing-product situation and the founder’s implementation resource.

offer.headline: Annotated Figma screens and a clickable prototype for one flow.
offer.body: Mina Studio reviews up to five existing onboarding or first-use screens. Include your product link or walkthrough and chosen first-use task; get one handoff call and one revision. Your developer implements.
offer.reason: Leads with tangible deliverables, then states the founder’s inputs and implementation responsibility.

tradeoff: Story makes the founder’s task and design mechanism explicit; offer gives more space to required inputs and the implementation boundary.
limitations: Editorial disclosure: Mina Studio and its persona are fictional demo material. No real clients, results, availability, booking or reputation are evidenced. The AI-generated portrait represents only the demo persona; retain a separate visible disclosure.
Intended customers are solo SaaS founders and small founder-led software teams with an existing product. Each option describes one flow of up to five screens; the founder’s developer implements it.

Work uses a product link or walkthrough recording, the founder’s chosen first-use task, and existing design files where available. Implementation, user interviews, brand identity, ongoing support and a full product redesign are excluded. Price, timeline, client results and guarantees are unknown.

The CTA opens a local illustrative sample, not contact or booking. Keep one human portrait and the same typography, background and layout. Copy was reviewed only; no implementation, visual, live-link, demand or conversion validation was performed.
